segments.text: 3. A Third Benefit that may be expected by the well-managing of this work, is this, It will make our publike preaching to be better underſtood and regarded. When you have acquainted them with the Principles, they will the better underſtand all that you ſay. They will perceive what you drive at, when they are once acquainted with the main. This prepareth their minds, and openeth you a way to their hearts: when without this you may loſe the moſt of your labour: and the more pains you take, in accurate preparations, the leſs good you do. As you would not therefore loſe your publike labour, ſee that you be faithful in this private work.
